profiles._comment_opening_loadout: THE TURN-ONE OUTFITTING WINDOW, AND THE ONLY SOURCE OF OPENING GEAR AND MATERIAL. A spawning band owns NOTHING - equipment.json ships `start_stock_fraction: 0.0` and no material declares a start stock any more - so the player composes the opening loadout after seeing the generated map, and anything unspent when the first turn advances is forfeited. TWO BUDGETS, AND ONLY ONE OF THEM IS CONFIGURED. The KIT budget is a MODEL FACT, not a dial: one kit per working-age hand of the band that actually spawned (~17 on the shipped 30-person band), derived from the band's own worker count so a retuned band size or working share moves it with no edit here. The MATERIAL budget is this number, in units - 1 point buys 1 unit - because there is no head count that says how much bone a band walked in with. `pickable_materials` is the pick list the client draws, in the order it draws them; a material absent from it cannot be bought at any price, which is how the three luxury crops and `hurdles` stay off a list nobody would spend on. `material_defaults` is the pre-filled allocation the window opens on - a suggestion the player is free to spend elsewhere, not a grant - and it must sum at or below `material_points` and name only pickable materials. Every picked unit arrives at the MIDDLE of the band table on every axis it declares (OPENING_MATERIAL_READING): what the band scavenged before setting out is unremarkable. `kit_defaults` is the kit column's twin pre-fill and is the one place the two shapes differ, because the KIT budget is not a number in this file: it is the spawned band's own working-age head count, so a defaults-sum check is not available at load time and the published pre-fill is CLAMPED PROPORTIONALLY to whatever budget the band turned out to have (with a warn when it binds). The shipped 4/4/4 = 12 against ~17 hands never binds; it opens the column on the three subsistence kits - Stalking, Trapping, Harvesting - so a player sees a plausible band rather than a column of zeros, and still has hands left over to spend deliberately.
